steps.userSide: Your Step: the last part of your Goal.

cards.text: We climbed North Truchas Peak in a thunderstorm and stood on the summit at 13,024 feet. I had wanted it badly.
The altitude is still in my head and legs, and the storm is not done with the peak. Two horses are gone and the way down is long.
I pull my gloves tighter and look at the wet rocks under my boots. Wind shoves at my coat.
I am uneasy, and the flat grey cloud building over the next ridge is what does it. My legs feel heavy and slow, and the canteen is lighter than I want.
